definitions.explanation: Fertilizer derived from natural, organic materials such as compost, animal manure, bone meal, or plant matter, as opposed to chemically synthesized fertilizers.

examples.japanese: {有機|ゆうき}{肥料|ひりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てている→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: I grow vegetables using organic fertilizer.

examples.japanese: {有機|ゆうき}{肥料|ひりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Organic fertilizer has the effect of improving soil quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{化学|かがく}{肥料|ひりょう}→化学肥料：17490_kagakuhiryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{有機|ゆうき}{肥料|ひりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More farmers are choosing organic fertilizer instead of chemical fertilizer.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧ (organic) and ⟦{肥料|ひりょう}→肥料：06102_hiryou⟧ (fertilizer). Increasingly common as interest in organic farming (⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧) and sustainable agriculture grows in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有機|ゆうき}{肥料|ひりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}す→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧: to apply organic fertilizer
- {有機|ゆうき}{肥料|ひりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{栽培|さいばい}する→栽培する：09860_saibaisuru⟧: to cultivate with organic fertilizer
- ⟦{完熟|かんじゅく}→完熟：27574_kanjuku⟧{有機|ゆうき}{肥料|ひりょう}: fully composted organic fertilizer

TYPES:
- ⟦{堆肥|たいひ}→堆肥：06471_taihi⟧: compost — decomposed plant matter
- {鶏糞|けいふん}: chicken manure
- {骨粉|こっぷん}: bone meal
- ⟦{油|あぶら}かす→油かす：29276_aburakasu⟧: oil cake; seed meal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{化学|かがく}{肥料|ひりょう}→化学肥料：17490_kagakuhiryou⟧: chemical fertilizer — the synthetic counterpart
- ⟦{堆肥|たいひ}→堆肥：06471_taihi⟧: compost — one specific type of organic fertilizer
- ⟦{肥|こ}やし→肥やし：30665_koyashi⟧: fertilizer; manure — more colloquial general term
